high_level_description: This image is a meme that humorously critiques the concept of trickle-down economics. The meme is divided into two sections with accompanying text. The top section has the heading "AFTER DECADES OF REAL LIFE EXPERIENCE... TRICKLE-DOWN ECONOMICS EXPLAINED" in bold white letters on a dark gray background. Below this heading, there's an illustration labeled "How we're told it works." This part shows a single wine bottle pouring red wine into a pyramid of wine glasses, with the top glass being the largest and the bottom glasses getting progressively smaller.
